quotes.title: Epsilon Cancri
quotes.card: Epsilon Cancri is a white-hued multiple star system in the zodiac constellation of Cancer.
quotes.introduction: Its name is a Bayer designation that is Latinized from ε Cancri, and abbreviated Epsilon Cnc or ε Cnc.
